package.description: Antenna and Radio Data File Editor

en-US.description: Antenna and Radio Data File Editor
en-US.longDescription: A separate application, AntRad, is used to create and edit radio and antenna data files for the Pathloss 4, 5 and 6 programs. The program is also used to convert version 4 data files to the version 5 format and version 5 to version 4. AntRad is included with the Pathloss 5 program and is also available separately as a free download.
en-US.name: AntRad

zh-CN.description: 天线和无线电数据文件编辑器
zh-CN.longDescription: 一个独立的应用程序 AntRad 用于为 Pathloss 4、5 和 6 程序创建和编辑无线电及天线数据文件。该程序还可用于将版本 4 的数据文件转换为版本 5 格式，或将版本 5 转换为版本 4。AntRad 随 Pathloss 5 程序一起提供，也可作为免费下载单独获取。
